correctness.rationale: Partition every interpretation into four nonnegative cells (a,b,c,d). All 64 ordered-noun atomic truth values are fixed by the four cell-positivity bits and signs of s=b−c, t=a−d, s+t, t−s, and conversely those data are recoverable from the atom truths. Classifying supports for (b,c) and (a,d) gives 2 zero-difference support patterns and four nonzero ones per pair, with three relative nonzero magnitude orders, hence 2·2+2·4+4·2+3·4·4−1=67 types after excluding the empty universe. Compress nonzero |s|,|t| to 1,2 preserving signs/order and each positive baseline, giving |M|<=4+3=7 for every type. Requiring four nonempty cells plus s>=1 and t>s forces |M|>=7, realized at (3,2,1,1). Jiang’s unrestricted-vocabulary spectrum-shape theorem yields only ordinary or even tails; the sharp size-7 bound restricts candidates to empty, T1..T7 and E2,E4,E6. The given explicit cell constructions realize all candidates and upward/even extensions. Independent full atomic semantic verification up to size 18 finds 67 types, with minimum-size histogram (4,6,16,9,20,4,8). The all-size reasoning relies on symbolic cell compression and Jiang’s theorem, not finite extrapolation.
